title: VPN Troubleshooting Guide
content: Check that the device has an active internet connection.
Open the VPN client and verify the VPN configuration.
Check the VPN server address.
Verify username, password and authentication settings.
Restart the VPN client.
Clear cached VPN credentials.
Try connecting to the VPN again.

title: Network Firewall Configuration
content: Verify that VPN traffic is allowed through the firewall.
For IPsec VPN connections, verify required ports.
Check that UDP port 500 is permitted.
Check that UDP port 4500 is permitted.
Contact the network administrator if firewall access is blocked.

title: VPN Authentication Problems
content: Verify the username and password.
Check multi-factor authentication.
Clear cached credentials.
Verify the configured authentication method.
Retry authentication after confirming account status.

title: Password Reset Guide
content: Open the company password reset page.
Enter the registered employee account.
Complete identity verification.
Create a new secure password.
Sign in again using the new password.

title: Network Connectivity Troubleshooting
content: Check the network cable or Wi-Fi connection.
Restart the network adapter.
Check the device IP configuration.
Restart the network connection if permitted.
Contact the network team if connectivity remains unavailable.

title: Software Installation Guide
content: Verify that the software is approved.
Check system requirements.
Run the installer with the required permissions.
Restart the system after installation if required.
Contact IT support if installation continues to fail.

title: Hardware Troubleshooting Guide
content: Check that the hardware device is connected correctly.
Restart the computer.
Check device drivers.
Try another compatible port if available.
Contact hardware support if the problem continues.

title: System Recovery Guide
content: Save any available work.
Restart the computer.
Check system updates.
Review system error messages.
Contact system administration if the issue continues.
